name: skout
description: Skript language server: errors as you type, completion and docs from your own server's syntax, go to definition, rename and a variables view across your whole project.

skout.skriptVersion.patternErrorMessage: A Skript version such as 2.16.2, or empty for the newest bundled version.
skout.skriptVersion.markdownDescription: The Skript version your server runs, e.g. `2.16.2`. Version-dependent rules follow it (function overloading since 2.12, `->` return types and named arguments since 2.14), and built-in functions come from the closest bundled version (2.14.3, 2.15.4, 2.16.2 or 2.17.1). Empty means the newest bundled version.

skout.knownFunctions.markdownDescription: Functions provided by addons (for example skript-particle), so calls to them are not reported as undefined. Addon syntax dumps will replace this in a later version.

skout.syntaxDumps.markdownDescription: Syntax dumps to load on top of the bundled Skript syntax: files, or folders (every `.json` inside), absolute or relative to the workspace. Accepts Skript's `docs.json` from `/sk gen-docs` (it replaces the bundled Skript syntax), [SkriptHub Docs Tool](https://github.com/SkriptHub/SkriptHubDocsTool) files from `plugins/SkriptHubDocsTool/documentation/`, and files saved by **Skout: Download Syntax Dump**.

enumDescriptions: Report a line only when changing one word makes it valid syntax, with a quick fix.
Also report every line that matches no known syntax, as information. Best once your addons' syntax dumps are loaded.
skout.unrecognizedSyntax.markdownDescription: How Skout reports lines that match no known event, effect, condition or section.

skout.diagnostics.indentation.markdownDescription: Report indentation that Skript rejects: mixed tabs and spaces, and lines indented deeper or shallower than their section allows.

skout.diagnostics.missingColon.markdownDescription: Report lines that are followed by an indented block but do not end with `:`.

skout.diagnostics.unclosed.markdownDescription: Report unclosed or unmatched quotes, `%` in strings, `{}` variables, `()` and `[]`.

skout.diagnostics.emptySection.markdownDescription: Report sections (lines ending in `:`) that have nothing indented under them.

skout.diagnostics.comments.markdownDescription: Report unclosed `###` block comments, and a `#` that silently starts a comment in the middle of a value (for example `<#ff0000>` in `options:`).

skout.diagnostics.undefinedFunction.markdownDescription: Report calls to functions that are not defined in the workspace and are not built into Skript.

skout.diagnostics.argumentCount.markdownDescription: Report calls to your functions with too many or too few arguments.

skout.diagnostics.duplicateFunction.markdownDescription: Report functions defined twice with the same argument types (or the same name, before Skript 2.12), including clashes with built-in functions.

skout.diagnostics.functionSignature.markdownDescription: Report function headers Skript cannot read, such as an invalid parameter definition.

skout.diagnostics.unknownOption.markdownDescription: Report `{@option}` references with no entry in the script's `options:`.

skout.diagnostics.unsetVariable.markdownDescription: Report variables that are read but never set anywhere they could be: in the workspace for globals, in the same trigger or function for locals.

skout.trace.server.description: Log the communication between VS Code and the Skout language server.

viewsWelcome.contents: No Skript variables yet. Open a folder that contains .sk files.
